items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Rhythm & blues, which I mean like Marvin Gaye and the Four Tops and I still am a big fan of James Brown.

ctx.x: Because the pop of the day was rock & roll.

Yeah. Rhythm & blues, which I mean like Marvin Gaye and the Four Tops and I still am a big fan of James Brown. And my friends were probably listening to — by the time I got into high school — it was rhythm & blues but it was also the Beatles and the Rolling Stones, and like that. And I liked some of that music. But that’s not what I dug. You know I would be listening to, I don’t know, Savoy Brown Blues Band and then I’d be playing Dexter Gordon and say who’s that? Dexter Gordon.
You had a secret you know.
